title: SOURCES SOUGHT/EOI FOR 3PL/WAREHOUSING/RECEIVING AT THE SAVANNAH RIVER SITE NEAR AIKEN, SOUTH CAROLINA
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF > ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF > SAVANNAH RIVER MISSION COMPLETION - DOE CONTRACTOR
description:
Savannah River Mission Completion, LLC (SRMC), the prime contractor for the U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Environmental Management (DOE-EM) Savannah River Site Integrated Mission Completion Contract (SRS IMCC), is conducting market research to identify companies capable of providing third-party logistics (3PL) services, including receiving and delivery operations. 

 SRMC is a team led by BWX Technologies, Inc. with partners Amentum and Fluor. Under the SRS IMCC, SRMC's critical scope includes, but is not limited to: 

 
	 Liquid Waste Stabilization and Disposition (and other potential responsibilities such as Nuclear Materials Management and Stabilization); 
	 Storage of Liquid Radioactive Waste; 
	 Remediation, Treatment, and Disposal of Nuclear Materials and Spent Nuclear Fuel; 
	 Decontamination of Nuclear Facilities and Equipment; and 
	 Project Management and Support Services. 
 

 Currently, the Savannah River Site Management and Operations (SRS M&O) contractor provides receiving, delivery, and receipt inspection services to SRMC. However,  SRMC is considering outsourcing the Receiving and Delivery functions to a qualified 3PL supplier . 

 This operation is expected to handle an average of approximately 1,900 receipts per month and must include at least seven (7) dock doors for efficient unloading of palletized materials from large trucks. Daily deliveries will involve up to seven (7) on-site drop points within a 5-mile radius of each other, with one additional weekly delivery to an off-site administrative office in Aiken, SC. 

 This posting is being issued to confirm interest from potential vendors who would like to participate in a possible future request for proposal (RFP) process. 

  Required Capabilities of the 3PL Supplier:  

  1. Warehouse Facility Specifications (SRMC Provided):  

  Note:  The warehouse facility will be provided by SRMC and will be located within a 40-mile radius of the Savannah River Site (SRS) near Aiken, South Carolina. Respondents should focus on their ability to provide 3PL services, staffing, and necessary equipment to manage operations within the provided facility. 

 
	 The warehouse facility has a minimum of 150,000 square feet of storage space, and will have an appropriate portion of office space for operational and administrative functions. 
 

  2. 3PL Service and Inventory Management:  

 
	 Capable of supporting third-party logistics services, including inventory management, order fulfillment, and capacity for Just-in-Time delivery coordination to SRS. 
	 Provide adequate staffing, with at least 20 qualified personnel to ensure efficient operations. This includes roles for inventory management, equipment operation, logistics coordination, and administrative support. 
	 Offer and maintain appropriate warehousing equipment, including forklifts, pallet jacks, and other tools necessary for efficient and safe handling of inbound and outbound deliveries. 
	 Support the efficient receipt of deliveries, including order reconciliation and proper documentation. 
	 Supply all required  labor, vehicles, material handling equipment (e.g., forklifts, pallet jacks) , and other necessary supplies to manage day-to-day operations.
	 
		  NOTE : SRMC will supply certain IT tools such as computers, printers, copiers, and scanners. 
	 
	 
	 Incorporate use of WMS (Warehouse Management Systems) for accurate inventory tracking and real-time reporting. Anticipate approximately 800-1000 material IDs valued at about $800M in inventory. 
 

  3. Delivery Coordination:  

 
	 Demonstrated capability to coordinate Just-in-Time (JIT) deliveries to SRS or other designated locations, ensuring accurate and timely order fulfillment. 
	 Provide resources for receiving, handling, and delivering materials/equipment to SRS at pre-scheduled intervals or as needed. 
	 Implement and manage clear procedures for shipment tracking, order reconciliation, and document handling. 
 

  4. Compliance and Experience:  

 
	 Knowledge of or the ability to adhere to all regulations related to the storage and transportation of sensitive, regulated, or hazardous materials, if required. 
	 Demonstrate the ability to scale operations, depending on varying demand levels for receiving and delivery services. 
	 Show evidence of a history of successfully providing similar services as required in this notice. 
 

 This  Sources Sought Notice  is not a solicitation but a request for information to help identify interested and capable sources. Please add your company information as the Interested Vendor and/or reach out to Grayson Judd at grayson.judd@srs.gov to be added to the Interested Vendor list.
